title: dev.qory.ping
description: Sent to the server's events endpoint before the runtime starts, when a server is configured. The server answers 2xx or the run does not start.

runner_version.description: The runner module version, as Go stamps it.

events.description: The event types the server will receive, as its configuration named them.

contract_version.description: The revision of this contract the runner implements, the same integer as the X-Qory-Contract-Version header.
